statement.sql: SELECT c.case_id, c.subject_ref, c.trigger_event_id, c.case_status, c.current_revision, c.effective_revision, c.created_at, c.updated_at FROM aml_case c WHERE c.case_id = @caseId

statement.description: Idempotency lookup: one Case per trigger event and subject.
statement.sql: SELECT c.case_id, c.subject_ref, c.trigger_event_id, c.case_status, c.current_revision, c.effective_revision, c.created_at, c.updated_at FROM aml_case c WHERE c.trigger_event_id = @triggerEventId AND c.subject_ref = @subjectRef

statement.description: Create a Case with no analysis yet.
statement.sql: INSERT INTO aml_case (case_id, subject_ref, trigger_event_id, case_status, current_revision, effective_revision, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (@caseId, @subjectRef, @triggerEventId, @caseStatus, 0, NULL, @now, @now)

statement.description: Store one analysis revision; the primary key rejects a duplicate revision.
statement.sql: INSERT INTO case_analysis (case_id, revision, execution_status, case_result, result_json, explanation_json, created_at) VALUES (@caseId, @revision, @executionStatus, @caseResult, @resultJson, @explanationJson, @now)

statement.description: Move the Case to a new revision; guarded so a late revision never overwrites a newer one.
statement.sql: UPDATE aml_case SET current_revision = @revision, effective_revision = COALESCE(@effectiveRevision, effective_revision), case_status = @caseStatus, updated_at = @now WHERE case_id = @caseId AND current_revision < @revision
SELECT a.case_id, a.revision, a.execution_status, a.case_result, a.result_json, a.explanation_json, a.created_at FROM case_analysis a WHERE a.case_id = @caseId AND a.revision = @revision

statement.description: Next claimable jobs, highest priority first.
statement.sql: SELECT j.job_id FROM job j WHERE j.status = 'PENDING' AND j.next_attempt_at <= @now ORDER BY j.priority DESC, j.created_at LIMIT @take

statement.description: Optimistic claim: 1 row affected means this worker owns the job.
statement.sql: UPDATE job SET status = 'RUNNING', lease_owner = @leaseOwner, lease_expiry = @leaseExpiry, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1 WHERE job_id = @jobId AND status = 'PENDING'

statement.description: New job; a duplicate idempotency key raises a unique violation (item already queued).
statement.sql: INSERT INTO job (job_id, job_type, batch_id, idempotency_key, payload, status, priority, attempt_count, next_attempt_at, created_at) VALUES (@jobId, @jobType, @batchId, @idempotencyKey, @payload, 'PENDING', 0, 0, @now, @now)

statement.description: A job this worker just claimed: retry count and durable input.
statement.sql: SELECT job_id, attempt_count, payload FROM job WHERE job_id = @jobId

statement.description: Success, with lineage to the Case and revision. Only the lease owner may finish the job.
statement.sql: UPDATE job SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', case_id = @caseId, analysis_revision = @revision, completed_at = @now, lease_owner = NULL, lease_expiry = NULL, error_code = NULL WHERE job_id = @jobId AND lease_owner = @leaseOwner

UPDATE job SET status = @status, next_attempt_at = @nextAttemptAt, error_code = @errorCode, completed_at = @completedAt, lease_owner = NULL, lease_expiry = NULL WHERE job_id = @jobId AND lease_owner = @leaseOwner

statement.description: Jobs whose worker died: back to PENDING, or DEAD_LETTER when the retry budget is spent.
statement.sql: UPDATE job SET status = CASE WHEN attempt_count >= @maxAttempts THEN 'DEAD_LETTER' ELSE 'PENDING' END, completed_at = CASE WHEN attempt_count >= @maxAttempts THEN @now ELSE NULL END, error_code = 'LEASE_EXPIRED', lease_owner = NULL, lease_expiry = NULL, next_attempt_at = @now WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_expiry < @now
SELECT job_id, idempotency_key, status, attempt_count, case_id, analysis_revision, error_code, completed_at FROM job WHERE batch_id = @batchId ORDER BY created_at, job_id

statement.description: Operator re-run: dead-lettered items get a fresh retry budget.
statement.sql: UPDATE job SET status = 'PENDING', attempt_count = 0, next_attempt_at = @now, error_code = NULL, completed_at = NULL WHERE batch_id = @batchId AND status = 'DEAD_LETTER'
